method: Family-level review of named owning notes, scope paragraphs, recorded corrections and supersession boundaries. All other document bytes and result JSONs are inventoried and text-scanned; that is not a claim to have independently checked their derivations. Dispositions control reuse and navigation, not whether the universe obeys a model.

docs/nsc-programme-method.md.reason: The w2 Hayward g>=-1 failure interpretation is superseded by the canonical correction. Preserve w2 bytes; do not resume work from this stale failure row.

lab/docs/child-neck/composite-layer-note.reason: Its 125-field floor and large layer cancellation were withdrawn after normal stress was included; the successor still lacks physical fill and energy-transfer dynamics.

lab/docs/child-neck/torsion-splitting-an.reason: Classical spin-polarisation splitting is not carried over to the field-operator mean field. The successor distinguishes C-even axial-axial coupling from conditional nonminimal vector-axial helicity terms.

lab/docs/child-neck/junction-neck-note.m.reason: The original bare-density neck radius is withdrawn; the later geometric-mass correction itself needs the exact-bounce versus density-cancellation distinction.

lab/docs/child-neck/israel-matching-note.reason: Baseline line 10 calls 1+adot^2=0 a bounce. child_expansion_ladder.py:4-5 carries the closed-FLRW -1 curvature term but explicitly neglects its small shift of the density-cancellation radius. At a real turning point adot=0 and 1+adot^2=1. Therefore zero geometric mass and exact onset at the cancellation radius cannot be imported as established bounce facts.
lab/docs/child-neck/israel-matching-note.post_baseline_correction: The integrating agent corrected the live owner, child-neck index and status on 10 October 2026; the original text remains in preserved baseline and commit ea5e334c. Numerical records are unchanged.

child_neck_subfamily_review.decision: Keep conditional production/Pauli-consistency diagnostics. The counts carry two factor-of-two corrections, a counting cutoff, one Kasner epoch, a manually chosen infall span and a species count explicitly recalled from memory. No equation or production law was independently verified here.

Keep dimension/epoch and conditional generation-map questions. Distinguish bare matter energy, geometric mass and exterior mass. The fixed-point claim is withdrawn, Omega=3.97 is not reproduced, and the child count assumes a fixed fermion content. A Hubble-mass coincidence uses free choices and is not a prediction.

Retain explicit baryon-number bookkeeping and the distinction between classical spin polarisation and field-operator helicity. Subsystem entropy needs a traced partner and does not derive time itself; the whole pure-state entropy is not that subsystem entropy. No dynamical baryogenesis or sourced helicity was constructed.

Borrow the ordinary TOV/expansion comparison instead of recomputing it. This note reports session-only numbers with no saved producer/record; its universal claim about every bounce's energy condition is not adopted without checking its assumptions.

Reuse standard angular junction conditions only with specified orientation and stress assumptions. The source is an effective fluid and omits torsion surface-spin terms. Exact density-cancellation versus real closed-FLRW bounce semantics need the recorded correction; no global child transition has been independently established.

Keep the sequence of pressure/normal-stress compatibility questions and explicit supersession. The latest balanced construction replaces the 125-field claim but still postulates negative-energy fill, uncomputed interlayer exchange and planar layers near a regime where self-gravity matters. A familiar plate formula does not supply the physical boundary.

Keep flux bookkeeping as a conditional neck-path readout. The w=-1/2 endpoint varies about 10 percent with tolerance; no microscopic destination for absorbed energy/quanta is supplied. Exterior vacuum is imposed, not evidence that a real sibling channel vanishes.

Keep alternative symmetry lifts as tests on a chosen free-field Kruskal-type geometry. The owner does not select a throat swap and does not derive the child as an image of the parent. Inside/outside therefore remains distinct from charge conjugation; imported transformation tables are not a discovery.

w2_subfamily_review.read_boundary: Full owner; charged-LLL module introduction and infall-winding section; full charged-twist-cliff-v3 record.
w2_subfamily_review.decision: Reuse the constrained Maxwell/Dirac/monopole source interface with fixed A/C_F and separate Gauss charge. Reflection on a finite fixed dyonic slice is exploratory; no charged backreaction evolution or child creation was demonstrated.

The four-rung ansatz is exploratory. First two rungs determine coefficients; later errors are about .07 and 11.6 percent. The producer hashes the cliff record but hardcodes rounded deficits instead of reading them: preserve that provenance caveat.
Seven empirical dimensionless coefficients and their numerical coincidences are hypothesis material, not fundamental or inherited constants. The owner explicitly acknowledges possible numerology.

Reuse the supplied-metric RK4/tangent observer adapter. The old saved excision integral is neither proper time nor a child clock; missing old stage data prevents recovering those old worldlines from the scalar alone.

w2_subfamily_review.read_boundary: Full time-awareness, wall-breathing-timescale, charged-clock-horizon and composed-vs-clock producers; time-awareness/charged-clock records; charged-LLL lines341-397 and reference lines310-347.
w2_subfamily_review.decision: Physical clock/winding interpretations remain unresolved: infall_winding and dependent producers use 1/(1+sqrt(f_RN)), while the declared PG metric has beta=sqrt(1-f_RN) and ingoing characteristic -(1+beta). Preserve records. This does not invalidate independently computed reflection modes or tangent-lapse shares.

w2_subfamily_review.read_boundary: Full note including rounds1-112 and full frontier-amendment-v1 record.
w2_subfamily_review.decision: Quarantine universal missing95/exterior-elimination language and coordinate-invariance claims. The wall>20 open-cell summary is stale after later saved records; the supersession does not authorise another campaign. Neutral/dyonic parameter comparison is not a chart-invariance proof.

finite_nesting.scope: Finite operator inheritance, Schur reduction, causal memory and a measured pair of nested spatial collars in one periodic spherical metric.
finite_nesting.review: The finite-window theorem imports Schur algebra and scale covariance. It permits distinct states and arbitrary finite depth. The pair note explicitly excludes a horizon junction, new manifold, regular spherical centre and eternal continuation.
finite_nesting.next_use: Reuse the finite graph/reduction algebra and pair observables. A branching atlas must expose whether an edge is a spatial restriction, operator coupling or actual spacetime transition; no relabelling of one as another.
finite_nesting.retire_from_active_path: Re-proving generic Schur complements or treating identical laws as identical regional states.
finite_nesting.verification_boundary: Existing finite record claims are cited, not independently replayed here. No black-hole offspring or cosmological abundance is established.

finite_discovery.scope: Saved periodic/conformal realizations, source interventions, moving regional ledgers, retained/exterior reduction and a finite grandchild handoff.
finite_discovery.review: The grandchild owner distinguishes an early unresolved forecast from a later declared proper-clock interval. Its propagated state, tangent, source and clocks are inherited rather than reinitialised. The memory owner reconstructs the full source before computing geometry forces; its memory kernel is not an extra stress.
finite_discovery.next_use: Use authenticated saved frames and existing observer adapters to populate finite atlas examples, with spatial versus modal partitions and clock semantics displayed.
finite_discovery.retire_from_active_path: Further autonomous periodic campaigns whose proposed output supplies no new cross-domain connection.
finite_discovery.verification_boundary: Scope review covers named owners; individual version notes and all trajectory arrays remain independently unverified. Finite effects do not prove continuum, renewal or universal scale inheritance.

conformal_realization.scope: The finite common-action conformal chain and its local-response successors, as routed by the active code map and frozen companion evidence.
conformal_realization.review: Keep source controls, actual metric curvature, proper clocks and local-response errors attached to their respective finite realizations. Earlier conditional reductions and later same-trajectory successors are distinct records.
conformal_realization.next_use: Populate an explicitly periodic finite atlas chart from saved evidence. Use the companion's domain without upgrading it to a global black-hole transition.
conformal_realization.retire_from_active_path: Navigation that presents earlier conditional response and its successor as interchangeable.
conformal_realization.verification_boundary: Family scope checked through the code map, paper coverage and realization audit. Individual successor derivations have been inventoried, not independently verified.

spherical_action.scope: Spherical action/source machinery, Galerkin variants, maintained regeneration episode, local response, null-expansion and initial-constraint checks.
spherical_action.review: The realization audit separates bitwise handoff, measured finite responses, initial bounds and an absent evolved error bound. Its goal_complete flag is explicitly not a universal verdict; renewal is false in the recorded maintained chain. Null-expansion samples are not a global horizon construction.
spherical_action.next_use: Reuse operators, energy accounting and observer diagnostics where the atlas chart has the same action, source and gauge. Preserve distinct initial, trajectory and continuum uncertainty fields.
spherical_action.retire_from_active_path: Superseded numerical controls as the default route; retain the original bytes and the successor relationship.
spherical_action.verification_boundary: No numerical trajectory or certificate recomputed during this census. An initial distance bound is not an evolved observable error bound.

rn_radial.scope: Magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom reference, radial Dirac/PG source and response, finite neutral continuation, gradient-bubble diagnostics and later radial variants.
rn_radial.review: The RN work audit records repeated rediscovery and withdrawn interpretations caused by mistaking chart cuts for physical nesting. The reference geometry map is a classical one-parameter chart. The full programme is not represented by its radial limitations. Reported shell and compression numbers require their named resolution and boundary conditions.
rn_radial.next_use: Keep RN as a calibrated atlas adapter and comparison chart. Borrow its known geometry. Admit a new computation only for a missing transition/source/coupling connection, with chart and observer identified.
rn_radial.retire_from_active_path: Automatic deeper marches, rediscovery of RN horizons or global verdicts inferred from a one-dimensional instrument.
rn_radial.verification_boundary: No continuum validation, production seal or demonstrated cosmological child is inferred. Branch-specific guard changes require a separate domain audit.

paused_incoming_gate.scope: The source-fixed incoming/KS gate, upstream signed-source arrays, UV/subgap work, derivative certificates and historical endpoint campaigns.
paused_incoming_gate.review: The gate remains OPEN and its campaign is paused. Active instructions explicitly make it neither a prerequisite for finite nested qualities nor a compulsory next research task. Four historical source objects and later recovered sources are needed by retained evidence closure.
paused_incoming_gate.next_use: Reuse an applicable source/certificate by its exact domain and dependency identity; otherwise keep this family outside the atlas's active compute route.
paused_incoming_gate.retire_from_active_path: The old error-budget cursor and generic repeated precision campaigns. Physical files may move only after reverse-dependency and restore checks.
paused_incoming_gate.verification_boundary: Hundreds of version notes and thousands of numerical rows are inventoried; the census does not close their physical gate or re-enclose their errors.

child_neck.scope: Uncommitted 7-9 October chain: Kasner production, Einstein-Cartan collapse, expansion, asymmetry, junction/neck layers and throat swaps.
child_neck.review: The owner states hypothesis-first, one Dirac field, a 10-solar-mass parent and mostly order-of-magnitude estimates. Its status note records six corrections and missing helicity, negative-energy-layer matter, spin junction terms, Planck-scale start and parent/child mass-ratio selection. It explicitly has no claim-ledger admission.
child_neck.next_use: Place its alternative mechanisms on the scenario atlas with borrowed-result links and declared assumptions. Review the latest note plus its correction history before selecting any missing physical calculation.
child_neck.retire_from_active_path: Superseded composite-layer and preliminary counting claims as current conclusions; preserve all original drafts and records.
child_neck.verification_boundary: Reading the status table and successful script regeneration are not independent physical verification. The existence and matter content of the proposed neck remain open.

w2_influence_interpretations.scope: Uncommitted w2 geometric-chain fees, radial influence atlas, constant tables and interpretations of the dark-sector fraction.
w2_influence_interpretations.review: The influence owner combines several distinct scalar fee definitions with a self-similar infinite sum and a .049 target/.03-.10 acceptance band. Failure of those conditional mappings cannot eliminate all exterior influence or establish interior dark matter. Its radial interval atlas is not a multi-child spacetime atlas.
w2_influence_interpretations.next_use: Preserve as alternative toy mappings. The atlas may show the recorded quantities and assumptions, never their unsupported universal elimination narrative. A finite depth or justified limit must be stated before future use.
w2_influence_interpretations.retire_from_active_path: The .049-target infinite closure as a default discovery target and the claim that an interior interpretation follows by elimination.
w2_influence_interpretations.verification_boundary: No w2 files edited or adopted. Every newly found w2 result remains exploratory until source/domain and interpretation are reviewed.

w2_radial_extensions.scope: Uncommitted w2 wall, march, two-end, charged, tilt, timing, production-preflight and bookkeeping extensions.
w2_radial_extensions.review: Inventory identifies this separate working stream and its dependencies. These results are not admitted merely because a script or a matching JSON exists; terminology such as wall, clock and quantum requires its defining quantity and domain.
w2_radial_extensions.next_use: Review each candidate's latest owning note and its claimed physical map before selecting reusable diagnostics. Retain w2 unchanged until reconciliation is explicit.
w2_radial_extensions.retire_from_active_path: Automatic chain-of-follow-up calculations driven by previous index rounds.
w2_radial_extensions.verification_boundary: Inventoried only at individual derivation level. No new physical verdict is assigned.

matter_torsion.scope: Particle/charge/nuclear sectors and torsion-derived matter mechanisms, including imported local constructions.
matter_torsion.review: The prior-art owner identifies established components and forbids treating their reproduction as NSC novelty. Shared coefficients, source/state compatibility and a new scale or transition connection are distinct from generic particle or soliton re-derivation.
matter_torsion.next_use: Borrow applicable formulas and constraints. Keep measured masses, imposed couplings and assumptions distinguishable from any new derived dimensionless relation.
matter_torsion.retire_from_active_path: Standalone reproduction of familiar particles, nuclear tables or torsion identities as discovery.
matter_torsion.verification_boundary: Individual sector notes are inventoried, not independently validated. No common-action closure of all matter sectors is asserted.

spectral_quantum.scope: Spectral action, determinants, anomalies, finite-domain quantum state and boundary response machinery.
spectral_quantum.review: The reuse owner distinguishes applicable imported determinant identities from the missing state/domain/source connection. Finite Dirac/Yukawa data remain inputs unless actually determined; a conditional holonomy saddle still requires a physical return loop.
spectral_quantum.next_use: Populate atlas links with operator, state, boundary domain and inherited versus measured coefficients. Use existing determinant and response identities without re-solving them.
spectral_quantum.retire_from_active_path: Raw determinant or coefficient scans without a newly missing compatibility relation.
spectral_quantum.verification_boundary: This is scope/ownership review through prior-art owners. Individual derivations remain independently unverified.

geometry_transition.scope: Compact/warped geometries, ADM necks, black-universe and horizon charts, clocks and proposed parent-child transitions.
geometry_transition.review: Existing regular black-universe examples establish possible geometries with their own sources. They do not identify our universe, supply the selected quantum source or turn a singular/infinite limit into a child transition. The transition map, conserved charges and observer semantics must be carried explicitly.
geometry_transition.next_use: Keep multiple geometry candidates and imported source conditions visible. Join charts only through a stated map; leave an absent arrow absent rather than filling it with a familiar equation.
geometry_transition.retire_from_active_path: Treating a coordinate inside/outside exchange as charge conjugation or proper-time dynamics without a supporting law.
geometry_transition.verification_boundary: Every geometry-family file is indexed; individual spacetime constructions and energy conditions are not re-proved here.

publication.scope: Foundation, companion and historical draft sources/PDFs plus claim bindings and selected evidence manifests.
publication.review: The existing claim-binding check resolves 27 claim markers and 95 record links. Nine registered findings include seven post-preprint findings. Conditional holonomy has a known unlinked record. The coverage note's old corpus counts are historical, not the current census.
publication.next_use: Link atlas results to their actual publication coverage and preserve frozen PDF/evidence identities. Update future publication coverage through the existing binding mechanism.
publication.retire_from_active_path: Treating either frozen paper as a complete account of all later laboratory work.
publication.verification_boundary: Structural claim-binding check ran; no paper rebuilt and no scientific claim independently verified.

governance_provenance.scope: Indexes, prior-art routing, claims, evidence receipts, source-history, storage and publication/lab separation.
governance_provenance.review: Root and lab are distinct publication and research owners despite many identical bytes. Historical PLAN copies are preserved inputs, not task authority. A retained PLAN versus the old check_current rejection is a known concrete inconsistency.
governance_provenance.next_use: Use this census to shorten active navigation, identify owners, distinguish same-byte aliases from variants and maintain original hashes. Retire redundant navigation before considering physical deletion.
governance_provenance.retire_from_active_path: Stale plan/handover cursors and any equation-selection monopoly inferred from historical framing.
governance_provenance.verification_boundary: Hashes establish identity. They neither establish theorem applicability nor authorise deletion of referenced historical evidence.

historical_archive.scope: Frozen drafts, old source/tests, pre-closure copies, imported external comparisons and archived campaigns.
historical_archive.review: The archive owner explicitly disclaims current scientific authority and records superseded rhetoric and invalidated claims. Original bytes are retained for provenance; revived ideas require a new active derivation rather than rewriting history.
historical_archive.next_use: Search as historical context and dependency source only. Any revival must identify the old failure and a new reason it can now be resolved.
historical_archive.retire_from_active_path: Already retired; keep ordinary atlas navigation pointed to current owners and show archives on request.
historical_archive.verification_boundary: Historical documents are fully inventoried and text-scanned but not scientifically reviewed as current proofs. No historical payload removed.

other_research.scope: Residual research records and support material not safely assigned by the documented family rules.
other_research.review: A complete census must expose this residual instead of inventing a scientific interpretation from a filename. Explicit links, path mentions, basename candidates and missing owners remain distinct.
other_research.next_use: Resolve the owning note and physical meaning before atlas admission or a new calculation. This disposition is a local boundary, not a verdict that the research lacks value.
other_research.retire_from_active_path: Unowned records as automatic compute instructions.
other_research.verification_boundary: Inventoried only. The family receives no scientific validation or rejection.
